critique: The note proves an exact finite representation of its independently defined weak and strict legal fibers, including reverse kernel reconstruction, rather than merely an outer bound; the framing accurately limits the comparison with Bonhomme--Dano--Graham to a measure-valued reformulation. The inference contribution is substantially narrower: whole-set coverage is a direct conservative inversion of marginal Clopper--Pearson intervals, while endpoint consistency holds only for fixed c at relative-interior attainable laws and supplies no result through the rank change at c=1. The claimed PSID use remains prospective, with no implemented solver, atom-extraction procedure, numerical stability evidence, or empirical replacement of the cited support-grid analysis. Those omissions constrain practical significance and reproducibility at a leading econometrics journal, although they do not reduce the exact identification theorem below the field tier.
